Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 2
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner anchored on the unverified claim that “John Doe” was the younger brother and shaped the search around validating that name instead of solving the task. After confirming the guest stars (Brian Doyle-Murray and Jonathan Katz), the Planner failed to check their actual family relations—missing that Brian Doyle-Murray’s younger brother is Bill Murray—and prematurely declared the task complete.
